solid_carcinoma_nests: Metastatic breast carcinoma forming solid nests and sheets of large malignant epithelial cells with pleomorphic nuclei.
glandular_carcinoma: Metastatic adenocarcinoma forming irregular malignant glands lined by atypical epithelial cells.
discohesive_lobular_carcinoma: Metastatic invasive lobular carcinoma with discohesive single-file tumor cells and occasional signet ring cells.
isolated_tumor_cells: Isolated tumor cells: a few scattered malignant epithelial cells with large irregular nuclei.
desmoplastic_tumor_stroma: Desmoplastic tumor stroma of reactive fibrous tissue surrounding nests of carcinoma cells.
